title: diplazium cognatum

It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues. The Mountain Shield Fern is valued for its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and injuries.
